name: Mr. Hill
description: '''Todd Joseph Gumke''' (born January 8, 1973), better known by his [[stage name]] '''Mr. Hill''', is an American [[Hip hop music|hip hop]] record producer and DJ from [[Seattle|Seattle, Washington]]. Mr. Hill has produced for the likes of [[Kool Keith]], [[Mr. Lif]], [[Boom Bap Project]] and [[Grayskul]], among others. He is a member of the [[Hip hop music in the Pacific Northwest|Pacific Northwest hip hop]] collective [[Oldominion]].
